title: A refused Close leaves a not yet Complete work order where it was
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location has no accounting integration (neither QuickBooks Online nor AccountingHub).
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status In Progress, with all lines done, not yet Complete, whose Shop supplies amount is $15.00.
  • Open work order 1 in two browser tabs, tab 1 and tab 2.
custom_steps:
1. In tab 1, click Close Work Order in the menu.
  2. In tab 2, change "Shop supplies" to $20.00.
  3. In tab 1, click Close Work Order in the confirmation.
  4. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The confirmation opens in tab 1.

Step 2:

  • Tab 2 saves the new amount.

Step 3:

  • Tab 1 shows "This work order changed. Review and close again."

Step 4:

  • Work order 1 is still In Progress, not Complete and not Closed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order)

  • S3-E5: “If lines, the shop supplies amount or the classification change after the confirmation opens, Close is refused with "This work order changed. Review and close again."”

From: Jira tickets under epic SV-11665 (saved 12 Nov 2026, sources/JIRA-SV-11665-tickets-2026-11-12.md), read 12 Nov 2026

  • Jira SV-11976: “A refused or failed Close leaves the work order where it was (not Complete), even when Close ran the completion steps.”
